<parameter=code>
def diff():
    b = previous_frame.ascii.split('\n'); c = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return [(i,j,b[i][j],c[i][j]) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if b[i][j]!=c[i][j]]
def sizes():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>5: out['green']=n['boundary']
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>5: out['yellow']=n['boundary']
    return out
# grow green (right slot), grow yellow (bottom slot)
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':21,'col':45}]); print("growG",len([d for d in diff() if d[0]<63]),"score",r.get('score'))
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':44,'col':24}]); print("growY",len([d for d in diff() if d[0]<63]),"score",r.get('score'),"lvl",r.get('level_completed'))
print(sizes())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
